name: taskchef
description: Dispatch work from a data-only workspace to visible Codex project tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch work to the right Codex project task.
interface.longDescription: Route actionable requests to independently openable Codex project tasks, keep an append-only task history, and query live reports on demand.
defaultPrompt: $taskchef-bootstrap Set up TaskChef in this folder.
$taskchef-delegate Dispatch this request to the right project.
$taskchef-report Report on work in the TaskChef task history.
